content.text: Last catalog item works fine. I've covered all four sections of the app thoroughly. Let me report the findings.

findings.summary: Selected Tier value is not passed to the form submission; the result always reports 'Basic' regardless of the visibly selected tier.
findings.failure_scenario: On the Form screen, open the Tier dropdown and pick 'Pro' or 'Max' (the button correctly updates to show the new selection), then submit. The result text always reads 'Registered ... (Basic, subscribed=...)' no matter which tier was chosen — reproduced consistently across Pro and Max. Name and Subscribe values wire through correctly, isolating the bug to the Tier field's submission binding (likely a stale/duplicate state variable read at submit time).

findings.summary: The displayed Total does not recompute when Quantity changes; it only refreshes when 'Apply discount' is tapped again, leaving a stale price on screen.
findings.failure_scenario: On Checkout, set quantity to 1 and tap 'Apply discount' (shows Total: $9). Increase quantity via '+' — the quantity field updates (e.g., to 2, then all the way to 10) but 'Total: $9' (or whatever the last-computed value was) remains on screen unchanged until 'Apply discount' is tapped again. A user could increase quantity expecting the shown total to reflect it and be shown a materially wrong price (observed a total for qty=2 still displayed while quantity read 10).

findings.file: Catalog item detail screen — Export button
findings.summary: The Export button gives no visible confirmation, error, or any state change when tapped.
findings.failure_scenario: From any catalog item detail (e.g., Item 001), tap 'Export'. No toast, snackbar, dialog, or visual change occurs, so the user cannot tell whether the action succeeded, failed, or did anything at all.

findings.summary: Quantity silently caps at 10 with no indication the limit was reached; the '+' button stays visually enabled and clickable past the cap.
findings.failure_scenario: Tap '+' more than 10 times on the Checkout screen; quantity stops incrementing at 10 with no toast/disabled state/visual cue, so repeated taps appear to do nothing without explanation.

findings.summary: The form's submit button (play-icon) has no text label or content-description, making it unlabeled for screen readers.
findings.failure_scenario: A TalkBack/screen-reader user navigating the Form screen reaches the icon-only submit button and hears no name or role announced, since the view hierarchy shows no 'txt' or 'a11y' value for that Button element.

content.text:
## Verdict: **DO NOT SHIP**

I exercised all four sections of the app (Catalog, Form, About/Diagnostics, Checkout) on a real device. The blocking issue is a genuine correctness bug in the Form:

**Blocking defects:**
1. **Form → Tier selection is not submitted correctly.** The Tier button visibly updates to "Pro" or "Max" when selected, but the registration result always reports "Basic" — confirmed reproducible for every non-default tier. Any real feature gated on this field (billing tier, entitlements, etc.) would silently apply the wrong tier to every user who isn't on Basic.
2. **Checkout → stale Total.** After computing a total via "Apply discount," changing the Quantity does not recompute the displayed total — it only updates the next time "Apply discount" is tapped. I reproduced this dramatically: total stayed at the quantity=2 price ($17) while the quantity field read 10. This is a real risk of showing a user an incorrect price.

**Non-blocking polish issues** (worth fixing but wouldn't alone stop a ship):
3. Catalog item **Export** button gives zero feedback (no toast/dialog/state change) — can't tell if it did anything.
4. Checkout quantity **silently caps at 10** with no indication the limit was hit; the "+" button stays clickable.
5. Form **submit button has no text/content-description**, so it's unlabeled for screen readers (TalkBack).

Everything else — Catalog list/detail navigation (all 13 items, including the last), About/Diagnostics static content, Subscribe toggle, Name field, and quantity floor-at-1 behavior — worked correctly.

Recommend fixing the Tier-submission bug and the stale-total bug (both are state-binding issues, likely quick fixes) before this build ships, and filing the three polish items as follow-ups.
